title: Acme + UML 2 State Machine schema bundle
description: Workspace schema bundle for this repository. It EXTENDS the built-in default bundle (the Acme base = ArchiMate 3.2 + ARGO extensions, resolved by the language-neutral name 'default') and adds a UML 2 state-machine profile (states + transition). The effective element universe is base union add, so every existing ArchiMate element/relationship remains valid while the coding business process can be modeled as a UML 2 state machine.
